title: Network Origins of the Money-Output Relation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a dynamic production-network model in which monetary non-neutrality emerges under fully flexible prices. Firms finance intermediate-input purchases from current nominal balances, and intermediate goods arrive with heterogeneous lead times across suppliers. A monetary shock then has two distinct effects. The first is miscoordination: because production uses dated input bundles assembled under past nominal conditions, the shock disturbs the composition of usable inputs (within and across firms) and thereby generates a deadweight loss. The second is reallocation: because the incidence of the shock is tilted toward smaller firms, which are disproportionately downstream, the shock redistributes resources along the supply chain. More specifically, positive shocks push resources downstream, negative shocks pull them upstream. This means that under a negative shock, both the miscoordination and the reallocation effect reduce

translated_title: 货币—产出关系的网络起源
translated_abstract: 本文构建了一个动态生产网络模型，在该模型中，即使在价格完全灵活的条件下，货币非中性依然会出现。企业以当期名义余额为中间投入品的采购进行融资，且中间品从不同供应商到达的交货周期存在异质性。因此，货币冲击会产生两种截然不同的效应。第一种是协调失灵效应：由于生产所使用的投入品组合是在过去的名义条件下组装的带时间标记的投入品，冲击会扰乱企业内部及企业之间可用投入品的构成，从而产生无谓损失。第二种是再配置效应：由于冲击的负担更偏向于规模较小的企业，而这些企业又不成比例地集中在产业链下游，冲击会沿供应链重新分配资源。更具体而言，正向冲击会将资源推向下游，负向冲击则会将资源拉向上游。这意味着在负向冲击下，协调失灵效应与再配置效应都会降低产出。
tldr: 本文提出动态生产网络模型，证明即使价格完全灵活货币仍非中性：货币冲击一方面因投入品时间错配产生协调失灵和无谓损失，另一方面会沿供应链再配置资源，正向冲击将资源推向下游、负向冲击将资源拉向上游。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dynamic production-network model showing that monetary non-neutrality emerges even under fully flexible prices, as monetary shocks create both a miscoordination deadweight loss through dated input bundles and a supply-chain reallocation of resources—pushing resources downstream under positive shocks and upstream under negative shocks.
